title: crataegus × intermixta
intro: Crataegus × intermixta, commonly known as the hybrid hawthorn, is a plant species that results from the cross-breeding of two different species within the Crataegus genus. This plant has been traditionally used to promote cardiovascular health and is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, triterpenoids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins. The health benefits of Crataegus × intermixta include reducing blood pressure, improving lipid profiles, and providing antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in supporting heart health and preventing cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents in this plant, such as flavonoids and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, may be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including vasodilation, improving endothelial function, and exerting antioxidant effects.
